sections.title: Workplace Styles Assessment
sections.description: Understanding your natural approaches and preferences in workplace scenarios
sections.instructions: For each scenario, indicate which approach more closely describes your typical response. There are no right or wrong answers. 1 = Strongly align with statement A, 2 = Mostly align with statement A, 3 = Mostly align with statement B, 4 = Strongly align with statement B.

questions.question: Section 1: Approach to Leadership and Influence
questions.description: This section explores your style in guiding projects, managing tasks, and influencing outcomes.

scenario.context: When leading projects and influencing outcomes in the workplace
scenario.prompt: Which general approach best describes your natural leadership style?

optionA.label: Structured & Direct
optionA.description: I tend to lean towards a more structured and direct approach - establishing clear plans, providing firm direction, and maintaining order.

optionB.label: Adaptable & Indirect
optionB.description: I tend to lean towards a more adaptable and indirect approach - finding creative solutions, using strategic influence, and maintaining flexibility.

scenario.context: You are leading a project that faces internal resistance to your planned approach.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically respond to this situation?

optionA.label: Reinforce the Plan
optionA.description: My instinct is to reinforce the established plan, emphasising structure and reliability to ensure a clear path forward. A grounded, proven approach demonstrates competence.

optionB.label: Find a Creative Way Around
optionB.description: My instinct is to find a creative or adaptable way around resistance, using strategic communication and indirect influence to maintain momentum without forcing confrontation.

scenario.context: You need to ensure a task is completed correctly and efficiently by your team.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically approach this?

optionA.label: Direct Oversight
optionA.description: I prefer to provide clear, direct oversight and set firm expectations. My focus is on bringing order and calm through structure.

optionB.label: Subtle Guidance
optionB.description: I prefer to use subtle guidance and strategic influence to empower the team. I may work behind the scenes to steer progress without micromanaging.

scenario.context: A decision you made is challenged by a colleague.

optionA.label: Defend with Rationale
optionA.description: I am inclined to defend the decision by explaining the rationale and structure behind it. I see challenges as potential disruption to an established plan.

optionB.label: Manage Diplomatically
optionB.description: I am inclined to manage the challenge diplomatically, potentially deflecting direct confrontation while seeking to understand the other perspective.

scenario.context: You are working towards improving a situation for your team or department.

optionA.label: Stability & Systems
optionA.description: My primary focus is on establishing stability, order, and clear systems the team can rely on. I show care by ensuring processes are robust and predictable.

optionB.label: Creativity & Transformation
optionB.description: My primary focus is on introducing creativity, growth, and transformation. I seek to enhance systems through innovation and exploring novel possibilities.

scenario.context: You are confronted with an unexpected problem that requires an immediate solution.

optionA.label: Apply Proven Framework
optionA.description: My instinct is to rely on proven procedures or quickly establish a clear, structured plan. I prefer to apply a reliable framework to bring the situation under control.

optionB.label: Solve Creatively
optionB.description: I am drawn to seeing it as a challenge to be solved creatively. I enjoy finding innovative solutions and am comfortable with ambiguity while exploring new angles.

questions.question: Section 2: Approach to Conflict and Collaboration
questions.description: This section explores your style in handling disagreements, communicating needs, and managing interpersonal dynamics.

scenario.context: When handling disagreements, communicating needs, and managing interpersonal dynamics
scenario.prompt: Which general approach best describes your natural style?

optionA.label: Direct & Action-Oriented
optionA.description: I tend to lean towards a more direct and action-oriented approach - addressing issues head-on, asserting my position clearly, and focusing on resolving problems quickly.

optionB.label: Consensus-Seeking & Harmonious
optionB.description: I tend to lean towards a more consensus-seeking and harmonious approach - prioritising relationships, seeking to understand others, and maintaining group cohesion.

scenario.context: You witness a colleague being treated unfairly.

optionA.label: Intervene Directly
optionA.description: I feel compelled to intervene directly and assertively. My priority is protecting the person and correcting the wrong, even if it creates friction.

optionB.label: Support Indirectly
optionB.description: My priority is to de-escalate tension and promote emotional safety. I am more likely to support privately or use indirect methods rather than direct confrontation.

scenario.context: A professional boundary you have clearly communicated is crossed.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically handle this?

optionA.label: Address Directly
optionA.description: I will likely address the issue directly and explicitly. My focus is on re-establishing the boundary, and I can move on quickly once resolved.

optionB.label: Address Carefully
optionB.description: I might feel uncomfortable with potential conflict and address the issue less directly. I may find it difficult to let go without full relational repair.

scenario.context: You need to express your needs or advocate for a specific outcome in a group meeting.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically approach this?

optionA.label: Direct & Assertive
optionA.description: I am comfortable being direct about what I want and stating my case clearly. I focus on the issue and am willing to be assertive to ensure my point is considered.

optionB.label: Harmony-Focused
optionB.description: I am highly attuned to the group's emotional state and others' needs. I might hesitate to voice my own needs if they risk disrupting harmony.

scenario.context: A disagreement arises that affects you personally.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically handle this?

optionA.label: Practical & Rational
optionA.description: I prefer to focus on the practical issue and take responsibility for my part, expecting others to do the same. I aim for rational discussion to solve efficiently.

optionB.label: Relationship-Focused
optionB.description: I am more focused on the emotional impact and state of the relationship. I may find unresolved conflict draining and prioritise feeling understood.

scenario.context: You need to navigate a working relationship where tension is present.
scenario.prompt: How would you typically approach this?

optionA.label: Open & Direct
optionA.description: I believe open and direct conversation is most effective. I am comfortable with constructive conflict and prefer to address issues head-on to clear the air.

optionB.label: Peaceful & Careful
optionB.description: I prioritise maintaining peaceful and kind interactions. I may avoid raising sensitive issues if I believe doing so will upset the relationship.

sections.title: Skills: Strategic & Commercial Acumen
sections.description: Self-assess your proficiency in each skill area
sections.helpText: 0 = No Experience, 1 = Developing, 2 = Proficient, 3 = Advanced, 4 = Expert
sections.sectionNote: Focuses on understanding the broader business context and thinking strategically to drive sustainable growth.
sections.interviewNote: These skill ratings are likely to be explored during interviews. Please be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your proficiency level.

questions.question: Strategic Vision
questions.description: Developing and articulating long-term vision

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Can articulate basic goals and contribute to team objectives
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Develops clear vision for own area; aligns work to broader strategy
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Creates compelling vision across functions; influences strategic direction
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Shapes organisational strategy; inspires others with transformative vision

questions.question: Long-Term Planning
questions.description: Creating and executing strategic plans

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Contributes to planning activities; understands planning frameworks
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Creates detailed plans for projects; monitors progress effectively
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Develops multi-year strategic plans; adapts plans to changing conditions
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Drives enterprise-wide strategic planning; balances competing priorities masterfully

questions.question: Market Analysis
questions.description: Understanding market dynamics and the competitive landscape

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Aware of key competitors and market trends relevant to role
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Conducts structured analysis of market segments and competitors
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Synthesises complex market data to inform strategic decisions
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Anticipates market shifts; recognised as authority on competitive dynamics

questions.question: Business Model Comprehension
questions.description: Analysing and evaluating business models

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands own organisation's business model and revenue drivers
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Analyses business model components; identifies strengths and weaknesses
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Evaluates and recommends business model improvements
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Designs innovative business models; advises on strategic transformations

questions.question: Financial Acumen
questions.description: Interpreting financial statements and key performance metrics

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Reads basic financial reports; understands key metrics for own area
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Interprets financial statements; manages budgets and tracks KPIs
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Conducts detailed financial analysis; identifies trends and anomalies
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Provides strategic financial insights; influences investment decisions

questions.question: Identifying Trends
questions.description: Recognising and assessing disruptive innovations and industry shifts

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Stays informed about industry news and emerging developments
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Identifies relevant trends; assesses potential impact on organisation
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Predicts industry shifts; develops proactive response strategies
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Shapes industry thinking; positions organisation ahead of disruption

questions.question: Strategic Evaluation
questions.description: Assessing strategic options and identifying when a pivot is needed

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Evaluates options within defined criteria; flags concerns appropriately
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Applies frameworks to assess strategic alternatives systematically
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Synthesises complex factors to recommend strategic direction changes
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Makes high-stakes strategic calls; navigates organisational pivots successfully

sections.title: Skills: Leadership & Talent Management
sections.description: Self-assess your proficiency in each skill area
sections.helpText: 0 = No Experience, 1 = Developing, 2 = Proficient, 3 = Advanced, 4 = Expert

sections.interviewNote: These skill ratings are likely to be explored during interviews. Please be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your proficiency level.

questions.question: Team Building & Motivation
questions.description: Creating cohesive, high-performing, and motivated teams

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Contributes positively to team dynamics; supports colleagues
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Builds rapport within teams; motivates others through enthusiasm (e.g., audit teams, risk teams, compliance functions)
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Creates high-performing teams; fosters strong team culture (e.g., building specialist risk/audit/controls teams)
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Transforms team dynamics organisation-wide; inspires exceptional performance

questions.question: Performance Management
questions.description: Setting clear goals and managing team performance

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Sets own goals aligned to objectives; tracks personal performance
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Sets clear goals for others; conducts effective performance conversations
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Designs performance frameworks; handles complex performance issues
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Shapes performance culture; creates systems that drive excellence

questions.question: Coaching & Mentoring
questions.description: Developing individual capabilities through effective coaching

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Shares knowledge willingly; helps colleagues when asked
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Provides regular coaching; helps others develop specific skills
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Uses varied coaching techniques; develops others systematically
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Transforms careers through coaching; develops coaching capability in others

questions.question: Talent Development
questions.description: Identifying skill gaps and creating development plans

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Identifies own development needs; pursues learning opportunities
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Assesses team capabilities; creates individual development plans
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Builds talent pipelines; implements structured development programmes (e.g., specialist development in risk, audit, compliance domains)
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Shapes organisational talent strategy; creates learning cultures

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Takes on delegated tasks; understands accountability

proficiencyDefinitions.4: Creates empowered cultures; enables autonomous high-performing teams

proficiencyDefinitions.3: Leads significant change initiatives; builds change readiness (e.g., risk framework transformation, compliance programme rollout)
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Drives transformational change; creates change-capable organisations

proficiencyDefinitions.3: Resolves complex multi-party disputes; prevents conflict escalation
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Transforms conflict into opportunity; builds conflict-resilient cultures

proficiencyDefinitions.2: Manages remote team members; adapts communication across cultures
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Leads geographically dispersed teams; builds inclusive remote cultures

questions.question: Succession Planning
questions.description: Identifying and nurturing future leaders

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Identifies potential in colleagues; supports their development
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Develops successors for key roles; creates development opportunities
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Builds leadership pipelines; implements succession frameworks
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Shapes organisational leadership capability; ensures continuity at all levels

proficiencyDefinitions.4: Masters organisational dynamics; achieves outcomes through influence
